patches.name: Krusadai Island Reef
patches.notes: Krusadai Island Reef ranks #9 of 17 by criticality (S = 0.056): removing it lowers IIC by 5.6%. It holds 195.2 ha, 2.9% of mapped habitat (#14 by area). Alternative routes exist around it; the network stays in 9 components. Segmentation confidence for this patch is 98%.
